description: Deterministic zero-install structural preflight for public GitHub repositories, with machine-readable output and local coding-tooling handoff.

operations.description: Browser-executed schema-v1 remote-preflight JSON for coding agents.

limitations: Remote analysis supports public GitHub repositories only and uses anonymous GitHub API data.
GitHub Pages cannot execute repository commands; local coding-tooling remains authoritative for conformance, environment verification, findings, validation, and mutations.
The analysis-json view is browser-executed rather than a server-side application/json HTTP API.
